pages.title: Ecolint: International School of Geneva
blocks: The world’s first international school, Ecolint has been a pioneer in international education for 100 years.
We offer a bilingual and globally-minded education, accessible to all children from Switzerland and beyond.
Director General's Welcome Explore our programmes

We are proud to celebrate consistently outstanding IB results year after year. Our latest cohort achieved a 97% IB Diploma pass rate, compared with 83% worldwide, and an average score of 35.8 points, against a global average of 31.

Our IB Career-related Programme achieved a 100% pass rate. These achievements reflect the dedication of our students and teachers and are all the more meaningful in an inclusive school where students with diverse strengths, backgrounds and educational journeys are supported to fulfil their potential.
Learn more about our academic excellence
Come see for yourself what makes us unique!

Join us at our upcoming Open House events to explore our spaces, meet our team, and get an inside look at everything we have to offer. Whether you’re curious, considering joining us, or simply want to learn more, you’re invited to step inside and experience Ecolint for yourself.
Ecolint blends academic vigour with pioneering innovation to inspire the young minds who will shape tomorrow’s world.
The world's first international school, where every student is welcome and can realise their full potential.
140 nationalities, 80 home languages: an international environment with unrivalled diversity.
A school for peace and humanitarian values
A not-for-profit foundation, our concept of education for peace is at the heart of everything we do.
The birthplace of the International Baccalaureate, and pioneer in child-centred education, Ecolint ensures that every student's individual needs are met.
Explore our programmes Learning support services
On each of our three campuses, students have access to a vast array of Extra-Curricular Activities, designed to broaden their horizons and develop new skills.

Our school has grown over time to meet increasing demand. Our three magnificent campuses, which today welcome 4,450 students, are united by the same values, while each having their own distinctive feel.

Register for our school holiday camps!

L’Ecole Internationale de Genève offers camps for 3 to 13 year olds during the school holidays. Our camps run from Monday to Friday (except public holidays) from 8h00 to 17h30 on our campuses in Geneva and Founex. Both staffing and facilities meet the very highest standards.

In order to expose our students to different world views, we invite guest speakers from across the world to come and share their stories and experiences. Whether they come from the worlds of literature, art, politics, journalism or sport, our guest speakers all share the same ability to inspire others through their personal testimony. Most guest speaker events are open to the public.

pages.title: Our Values ​​| Ecolint | International School of Geneva
blocks: Our international school is characterised by strong humanitarian values and our long history. We commit to following, reviewing and enriching our founding principles in our dedication always to do better than our previous best while remaining true to our mission.

Founded in 1924 by local educators and civil servants from the League of Nations and the International Labour Organization (ILO), Ecolint is built on the values of respect for all human beings and the promotion of peaceful coexistence amongst all peoples.
Through the years, the school has remained vigilant, always seeking to improve the ways in which these principles are applied within the community.
We make sure to keep our staff and students' well-being at the heart of everything we do by regularly reviewing our policies, procedures and statements.

pages.title: Why Ecolint | International School of Geneva
blocks: Choosing a school – especially in the Geneva area - can be quite bewildering, with many establishments seeming to offer similar academic programmes, excellent extra-curricular opportunities and modern facilities.

We believe that what sets us apart – and why visitors from the Council for International Schools recently underlined "the unique nature of Ecolint, a school whose impressive history covers almost 100 years" - are the following key reasons:
Ecolint blends academic vigour with pioneering innovation to inspire the young minds who will shape tomorrow’s world.

Having espoused the concept of child-centred education since our foundation in 1924, we have been innovating pedagogically ever since. The birthplace of the International Baccalaureate Diploma Programme, we are extremely proud of our rigorous academic approach and the results we achieve in all our programmes, especially in light of our inclusive admissions policy.

Founded in 1924 by civil servants from the ILO (International Labour Organization) and the League of Nations (the precursor to the UN) as the world’s first ever international school, we remain one of the most diverse school in the world. With 130 nationalities and 80 mother tongues, Ecolint offers its students an extraordinarily rich international environment.
Educating for peace and humanitarian values

We exist to educate for peace and to inculcate strong humanitarian values of inclusiveness, respect and inter-cultural understanding in everything we do. Resolutely not-for-profit, mankind is the only beneficiary of our work, not corporate shareholders or private equity firms.
